scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure
scenarios.reasoning: The agent provided a reasonable high-level summary of the build failure, correctly identifying the F# compiler error types and the HotReload test files as the source of errors. However, it missed a failing project (FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests), completely omitted target framework information, and only sampled 10 of 170 errors before drawing conclusions. The approach was reasonable but the limited error sampling led to an incomplete picture. The recovery from initial path errors was handled well, but the agent could have been more thorough in retrieving the full error set.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files
